fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: Approved UTILITY template with a DOCUMENT header. Leave empty to send a plain document message, which WhatsApp only allows inside the 24 hour customer service window.
fields.label: Template Name

fields.description: Comma separated, in template placeholder order. Allowed: customer_name, invoice_no, grand_total, outstanding, branch, date.
fields.label: Body Parameters

fields.options:
1. In Meta Business Suite create a WhatsApp Business Account and add the store's phone number.
  2. Create a Utility template with a Document header and a body such as Hello {{1}}, your bill {{2}} for {{3}} is attached. Wait for approval.
  3. Create a permanent system user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and paste the token and the phone number ID here.
  4. Enable, save, then use WhatsApp bill on the POS receipt or tick auto-send.

Every bill is sent as a PDF attachment. Customers must have given consent to receive WhatsApp messages; keep the number in customer_mobile with country code.
